speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 护士站的上午比坂口预想中还忙。七瀬恋正核对交接记录，坂口把一份尚待确认的手术申请递给她。
en: The nurses' station is busier this morning than Sakaguchi expected. Ren Nanase is checking the handover records when he hands her a surgery request awaiting confirmation.

speaker: 坂口
zh_CN: 「七瀬，明天上午手术室不是还有空档吗？我想问能不能把这台手术提前排进去。」
en: “Nanase, isn't there still an opening in the operating room tomorrow morning? I wanted to ask whether we could move this operation up.”

speaker: 恋
zh_CN: 「我看一下……手术室那边的确还有时间。」
en: “Let me check... Yes, there is time available in the operating room.”

speaker: 坂口
zh_CN: 「那就可以安排了？」
en: “Then we can schedule it?”

speaker: 恋
zh_CN: 「还不行。那张表只管手术室，不管护理人员。」
en: “Not yet. That schedule only covers the operating rooms, not the nursing staff.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 她将申请压在护理联络夹上。
en: She places the request on the nursing liaison folder.

speaker: 恋
zh_CN: 「这件事我得先问护理部。」
en: “I'll have to ask the nursing department about this first.”

speaker: 坂口
zh_CN: 「……这么严格？」
en: “...Is it that strict?”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 恋点点头，拿着申请往护士站里面的办公区域走去。
en: Ren nods and takes the request toward the office area inside the nurses' station.

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 坂口仍站在护士站的办公桌旁。刚才的七瀬恋已经拿着申请离开画面。镜头不换地点。短暂安静后，一个清冷的女性声音从坂口身后传来。
en: Sakaguchi remains beside the desk at the nurses' station. Ren Nanase has left the frame with the request. The scene stays in the same location. After a brief silence, a cool female voice comes from behind him.

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「需要我解释为什么吗？」
en: “Would you like me to explain why?”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 坂口转过身。
en: Sakaguchi turns around.

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 来人是一名身材修长的黑发女性。衣着干净利落，胸前的工作牌标着护理管理职务。她手里拿着两张不同的排班表和刚才那份申请，脸上没有明显的不悦，也没有半点要寒暄的意思。
en: The woman before him is tall and slender, with black hair. Her clothes are neat and practical, and the badge on her chest identifies her nursing management role. She carries two different staffing schedules and the request from a moment ago. Her face shows no particular displeasure, nor any inclination to make small talk.

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「石神千鹤。护理部。」
en: “Chizuru Ishigami. Nursing department.”

speaker: 坂口
zh_CN: 「坂口隆司。」
en: “Ryuji Sakaguchi.”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「我知道。」
en: “I know.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 石神把两张表分别放在桌上，将手术申请压在一旁。
en: Ishigami places the two schedules separately on the desk and sets the surgery request to one side.

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「这是手术室使用表。」
en: “This is the operating room schedule.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 她指向另一张。
en: She points to the other sheet.

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「这是护理人员配置表。」
en: “This is the nursing staff allocation schedule.”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「你刚才看的是第一张。」
en: “You were looking at the first one.”

speaker: 坂口
zh_CN: 「……第二张我确实没有确认。」
en: “...I haven't checked the second one, that's true.”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「那就先不要说已经能安排。」
en: “Then don't say it can already be scheduled.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 坂口低头细看。手术室空档与护士交接时间并没有整齐地重合。
en: Sakaguchi looks down more closely. The available operating room slots do not neatly line up with the nurses' handover times.

speaker: 坂口
zh_CN: 「原来这里空着的只是房间。」
en: “So all that's free here is the room.”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「正确。」
en: “Correct.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 她将表格重新叠齐，语气依旧平淡。
en: She stacks the schedules neatly again, her tone as level as before.

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「护士不是手术室里自动生成的。」
en: “Nurses don't automatically materialize in operating rooms.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 坂口一时没接上话。
en: For a moment, Sakaguchi has no reply.

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 石神没有催促，也没有借机训人，只是把护理交班的位置标给坂口看。
en: Ishigami does not hurry him or take the opportunity to lecture him. She simply points out the nursing handover on the schedule.

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「明天上午这段时间，病区需要完成交接。下午的巡回人员也已经有安排。」
en: “During this period tomorrow morning, the wards need to complete handover. The afternoon circulating staff already have assignments, too.”

speaker: 坂口
zh_CN: 「如果临时调整一下呢？」
en: “What if we made a last-minute adjustment?”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「可以讨论。先确认谁被调整，原来的工作交给谁。」
en: “We can discuss it. First establish whose assignment changes and who takes over their original duties.”

speaker: 坂口
zh_CN: 「我本来只想让患者少等一天。」
en: “I only wanted the patient to wait one day less.”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「这个理由我接受。」
en: “I accept that reason.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 坂口稍稍抬头。她却没有就此答应。
en: Sakaguchi raises his head a little. But she has not agreed to the request.

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「但不能让患者少等一天，就让护士多上一班。」
en: “But saving the patient a day's wait cannot mean giving a nurse an extra shift.”

speaker: 坂口
zh_CN: 「我没有要她们加班的意思。」
en: “I didn't mean to make them work overtime.”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「意图不会自己变成排班。」
en: “Intentions don't turn themselves into staffing schedules.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 石神合上表格，看着坂口。
en: Ishigami closes the schedules and looks at Sakaguchi.

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「我不是来阻止你做手术的。」
en: “I'm not here to stop you from operating.”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「医生负责判断什么时候该做。护理部负责确认有没有人能够安全地接下这份工作。」
en: “Doctors decide when an operation should be done. The nursing department confirms whether there are people who can safely take on the work.”

speaker: 坂口
zh_CN: 「明白了。那我应该怎么申请？」
en: “Understood. How should I submit the request, then?”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 石神似乎对这个问题比对刚才的解释满意一些。
en: Ishigami seems a little more satisfied with this question than with his earlier explanation.

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「预计用时、需要的器械护士和巡回护士、术后交接要求，提前交给护理部。」
en: “Send the nursing department the estimated duration, the scrub and circulating nurses required, and the postoperative handover requirements in advance.”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「能调整，我会答应。调整不了，我也会把原因告诉你。」
en: “If we can adjust the schedule, I'll agree. If we can't, I'll tell you why.”

speaker: 坂口
zh_CN: 「如果确实安排不开呢？」
en: “And if there really isn't a way to fit it in?”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「一起找下一个合适的时间。」
en: “We find the next suitable time together.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 她停了一瞬。
en: She pauses briefly.

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「这是医院。医生、护士、患者，都得等得到自己的那一份安排。」
en: “This is a hospital. Doctors, nurses, and patients all need to be able to count on arrangements that work for them.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 坂口把申请重新拿过来，翻到原先空着的护理协调栏。
en: Sakaguchi picks up the request again and turns to the nursing coordination section he had left blank.

speaker: 坂口
zh_CN: 「那这份我先补完整。没有得到护理部确认之前，不向患者保证具体时间。」
en: “Then I'll fill this in properly first. I won't promise the patient a specific time before the nursing department confirms it.”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「这样就对了。」
en: “That's right.”

speaker: 坂口
zh_CN: 「以后临时加台，我会先通知护理部。」
en: “From now on, I'll notify the nursing department first when adding an operation at short notice.”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「不必等以后。这张先补完。」
en: “No need to wait until next time. Finish this one first.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 坂口忍不住笑了一下。石神的神色没有变化。
en: Sakaguchi cannot help smiling a little. Ishigami's expression does not change.

speaker: 坂口
zh_CN: 「石神护士长，看来以后得经常麻烦您。」
en: “Head Nurse Ishigami, I suspect I'll be troubling you quite often from now on.”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「把资料填清楚，不算麻烦。」
en: “If you fill in the information clearly, it isn't trouble.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 她拿起护理配置表，准备离开。
en: She picks up the nursing allocation schedule, preparing to leave.

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「还有一件事。」
en: “One more thing.”

speaker: 坂口
en: “Yes?”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「病区忙的时候，请不要当着患者的面讨论谁不愿意加班。」
en: “When the wards are busy, please don't discuss who is unwilling to work overtime in front of patients.”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「护理部会负责协调。患者只需要知道，医院有没有把她安排妥当。」
en: “The nursing department will handle the coordination. All the patient needs to know is whether the hospital has made proper arrangements for her.”

speaker: 坂口
zh_CN: 「我记住了。」
en: “I'll remember that.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 石神轻轻点头，带着排班表离开护士站。她没有笑，也没有额外说一句客套话。
en: Ishigami nods slightly and leaves the nurses' station with the schedules. She does not smile or add any polite pleasantries.

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 坂口看了看手中那份尚未填完的申请，拿起笔在护理协调栏里补上预计用时、人员需求和交接安排。
en: Sakaguchi looks at the unfinished request in his hand, picks up a pen, and fills in the estimated duration, staffing needs, and handover arrangements in the nursing coordination section.
